request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: A small colour change only: his skin (face, ears, chest, belly, arms, hands, legs, feet) becomes clearly lighter, a mid-tone leaf green, with the shadow tone only a little darker than the light tone, so the arms and legs are not dark; not yellow, not pale. Keep everything else exactly the same: the orange-brown leather cap, crossed straps and loincloth, the belt, wrist bands, dagger, eyes, teeth, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
